text: An Analysis Crystal can form any microcore except the Omni Microcore, then split it to recover more material than you started with. This is a handy source of early supplies. Later, a Crystallized Philosopher's Stone lets you repeat the cycle by hand without wearing out your tool.
Each microcore always yields the same material when split.

Earth Microcore → Dirt
Water Microcore → Cod
Fire Microcore → Coal
Air Microcore → Feather

Light Microcore → Crude Light Core
Dark Microcore → Shadow Mist
Time Microcore → Time Warp Point
Space Microcore → Spatial Fold Point
